actions.title: Agricultural transport and dyed-diesel emergency directives
actions.description: Signed October 13. To the extent permitted by law, directs ADOT to treat qualifying agricultural loads of 80,001–90,800 pounds as nonreducible for permitting on non-interstate highways and waive fees for permits issued. Directs covered state agencies to deprioritize dyed-diesel enforcement for specified agricultural uses on non-interstate roads. Requires ADOT staff notification/training by October 16. Effective October 16 through December 31, 2026 unless rescinded earlier. The order preserves applicable law and existing agency powers; defined agency exclusions apply.
actions.locator: Signed PDF pages 1–3, especially operative paragraphs 2–4 and 7–11; signature date on page 3
limits: All three rendered pages visually inspected. Public official download worked with normal curl/TLS while Python request returned 403; both receipts retained.
This verifies issuance and operative text, not compliance, implementation, measured fuel/food savings or fulfillment of broad affordability promises.
